title: Galois transitivity on fibres of an affine base change
statement: Let k and K be fields with a possibly infinite Galois extension K/k. Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] with a morphism f:X -> Spec(k) [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let p:X_K -> X be the first projection of its base change [def-pc-base-change]. For points x,y of X_K with p(x)=p(y), there is a k-algebra automorphism sigma of K for which (id_X times Spec(sigma))(x)=y. This is the action on scheme points, not merely rational points.

source.place: Algebra.IsInvariant.exists_smul_of_under_eq_of_profinite, transported through tensor invariants and affine spectra; Stacks Tags 0BRI and 038A give the finite prime theorem and scheme action

proof.text: Use the canonical isoSpec of X and the ring homomorphism recovered by Spec.fullyFaithful.preimage to put a k-algebra structure on its global sections A. Construct the pullback comparison by pullback.map, then compose with pullbackSpecIso. Its first projection corresponds to includeLeft, and its second to includeRight.
Transport hxy through the first projection identity to equality of contractions of the two tensor-spectrum points. Apply Algebra.TensorProduct.exists_comap_eq_of_galois to obtain sigma.

The tensor map id_A tensor sigma fixes includeLeft and intertwines includeRight with sigma. Apply pullback.hom_ext after cancelling the comparison inverse to show that baseChangeMap and Spec of the tensor map agree through the comparison. Evaluate the equality at x and use injectivity of the comparison homeomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem exists_galois_map_eq_of_affine_projection_eq (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [IsGalois k K] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x y : ↥(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))) (hxy : (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) x = (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) y) : ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, (baseChangeMap f (specAlgEquivOver σ)) x = y
